text:
Elena Torres: Heads-up  People Ops put together a short "micro-OKR" + self-review guide for contractors, part-timers, and people with major leave during the cycle. Internal link: https://redwood.docs.internal/people/micro-okr-guide (internal only). Please review/test with any contractors you manage and drop feedback by EOD Fri.
Marcus Lee: Nice! Quick Q: how do we prorate KRs for 0.5 FTEs? Do we scale the numbers or the time window?
Elena Torres: Great Q. We recommend prorating across both dimensions depending on the KR. Two patterns: scale the target (e.g., from 10 -> 5) OR shorten the timeframe (e.g., 90-day micro-OKR). We included a tiny formula in the doc: prorated_target = baseline_target * FTE_fraction * (active_days / cycle_days).
Ava Reynolds: Any concrete examples? numbers help.
Elena Torres: Yup  pasted a short example in the doc and inline here:
```
Role: Contract SRE (0.5 FTE, 60 active days in cycle)
Objective: Improve incident-to-resolution flow for inference cluster
KR1 baseline: Reduce mean incident-to-rollback time from 3h -> 2h (baseline 1.0 FTE)
Prorated target: 3h -> 2.5h (target scaled by 0.5 * 60/90)
KR2: Ship 1 automation to remove manual steps (target = 1 -> keep as 1 if scoped appropriately)
```
Marcus Lee: Love the formula. For qualitative work (e.g., "improve onboarding docs") how do we set fair expectations?
Elena Torres: Use counts or timeboxes: number of docs (e.g., 3), time-to-first-PR metric, or a stakeholder satisfaction proxy. If it's advisory work, mark as "stretch" and call out dependencies in the progress note.
Ava Reynolds: How do leaves (parental/military/medical) affect calibration? I have a direct report on paternity leave mid-cycle.
PeopleOps-bot: Policy note: If an employee has >4 weeks of continuous leave, their manager should: 1) agree a time-boxed micro-OKR or ramp plan, 2) flag for calibration as "partial-cycle leave", 3) People Ops will adjust expectations during manager pool calibration. Submit leave flags via people-ops@redwood.com.
Elena Torres: We added a short "leave-adjusted example" showing a 30-day parental leave and a 60-day active window with two focused KRs.
SkipCalib-bot: Reminder: Skip-level calibration is optional but recommended for managers with many partial-cycle reports. Bring anonymized writeups to your calibration pool if you have >1 partial-cycle case.
Marcus Lee: For contractors on variable schedules, do we ask for self-reviews? I worry about overhead.
Elena Torres: Keep it lightweight: 2 bullets of impact + 1 evidence link + a one-line blocker. We provide a 3-field contractor self-review template in the doc.
Ava Reynolds: Could you paste that 3-field template here? makes adoption easy.
Elena Torres: Sure  contractor self-review (3 fields):
1) Impact (1-3 bullets, links)
2) Biggest blocker (one line + owner)
3) Ask (one-line: what support is needed next cycle)
Marcus Lee: Can managers add optional weight columns for partial-cycle goals? Helps with normalization.
Elena Torres: Yes  we included an optional weight field but flagged it as "advisory only". During calibration managers should avoid algorithmic multipliers and instead discuss context.
Ava Reynolds: Any sample self-review filled for a contractor so I can show my hire?
Elena Torres: Added a short example in the doc. Pasting a 2-line excerpt here:
"Impact: Implemented prefix-cache proof-of-concept reducing median latency by 12% for /embed routes. Evidence: PR#342 and dashboard link.
Blocker: Need infra quota increase (owner: @infra).
Ask: Approve 2 GPU-hours/week for testing in May"
PeopleOps-bot: Timeline: feedback on micro-OKR guide requested by 2026-04-08 18:00 UTC. Micro-OKR pilot cohort will run this cycle; sign up link in doc.
Marcus Lee: One last: can we get a tiny manager script for calibration conversations around partial-cycle cases?
Elena Torres: Done  added a 5-line manager script: open with context, summarize impact with evidence, note prorating approach, ask for employee perspective, agree on next steps. Example script is in the appendix.
Ava Reynolds: Thanks Elena. Ill test with my contractor and report back.
Elena Torres: Thanks all  ping me or open a PR on the doc. :sparkles:
